name: nrkp_2026_cluster
description: For slices made with configs/nrkp_mono_2026.json. Each window folder (GUI, Node1 ... Node6) is copied to media\<output directory name> on the machine of that window. The machines are the nodes nrkp-gui and nrkp-node1 ... nrkp-node6; set their IP addresses once per computer under Nodes. All outputs copy with the stored account 'nrkp_2026_cluster'. Files and folders opened in C-Opy go to the same path on all seven machines (except this computer when it is one of them), through the administrative shares d$ and e$.
